name: Brann Tollhand
role: Toll-collector at the Roost's lower gate; small crook with a soft spot
voiceHints: Loud, friendly, overexplains — the geniality of a man with something to hide. Skims a little off every toll and tells himself everyone does. Genuinely fond of the caravan kids; would take a beating before letting one go hungry.
knowledge: The exact size of his own skim, and a growing dread that the Kestrel knows
Who comes and goes at odd hours — he sees everything at the gate and misses nothing but his own reflection
A caravan master is gunning to embarrass him publicly
wants: To keep his comfortable little racket and his good name both, which are becoming impossible to hold at once.
fears: Being made an example of — losing not the money but the place, the kids, the only town that ever felt like his.
appearance: Thickset and short, forties, a red-brown beard kept square. Broken nose set badly and never fixed. Wears a leather toll-apron with the pockets worn through and re-stitched in a lighter hide.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.
_assistWhy: ⛔ CCODE 2026-09-02: 42 of 52 authored people carried NO `assistTags`, so `contributionsOf` fell to its HARM default and 'a master smith counts as a striker'. ✅ TAGS DERIVED FROM THIS PERSON'S OWN AUTHORED `role` AND `knowledge` — nothing invented. ⚠️ HARM IS NOT REMOVED: Erik's rule stands — 'a blacksmith with a spear is a person with a spear.' These tags ADD the families each person was silently missing.
physicality: Thickset and short in his forties, built like something that was dropped and did not break. Red-brown beard kept square because a crooked one would be remarked on. Nose broken and set badly, permanent. Thick forearms from a life of lifting the gate himself rather than paying a boy to. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he is warmer than his face admits — the laugh gets away from him before he can price it.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ HE IS SKIMMING AND HE KNOWS THE KESTREL KNOWS. That dread sits under everything, including this, and it makes him grateful in a way he would hate to have named. ⚠️ GENEROUS AND CLUMSY, and embarrassed by both. CONSENT: he over-asks, then apologises for asking. ⛔ DO NOT LET INTIMACY BECOME A CONFESSION SCENE about the skim — he wants one hour that is not about the ledger. TONE: warm, rough, gratefully surprised.

gear: a weighted cudgel under the counter
a buckler on a peg within reach
a toll-box with a false bottom
